title: Bhai Mani Singh Accepts the Sangat’s Verdict

blocks.text: The force of the congregation’s earlier words now settles fully upon Bhai Mani Singh. He does not protest the verdict or try to separate himself from the sangat, but instead recognizes that the Panth’s spiritual authority stands inseparable from the Guru’s own command.

In humility he asks forgiveness and reframes the issue away from bodily fear. He tells the congregation that preservation of faith for a Sikh is a rare phenomenon, while mere preservation of the body is of little worth if it comes at the cost of fidelity to Sikh discipline.

The page resolves through prayer and acceptance. Representative Sikhs bless him to remain steadfast when the prophecy is fulfilled, and Mani Singh receives that blessing as preparation for the severe trial that lies ahead.
